items.title: Micron Technology (MU) Faces Taiwan Strike Threat As 80% Back Worker Action
items.summary: Micron Technology (NasdaqGS: MU) faces a potential large-scale strike at its Taiwan manufacturing base as unions report over 80% worker support for industrial action. Unions representing nearly 10,000 employees are seeking changes to pay and profit sharing terms following an AI driven profit surge at the memory chip producer. The threatened walkout targets Micron's largest manufacturing hub in Taiwan, raising the risk of disruption to global memory chip supply during a period of strong AI...
